spec.description: Thermotec Rockwool is a heavy duty foil faced, pre-formed pipe lagging suitable for applications not exceeding 650°C steam lines and most industrial and commercial applications.

technical.value: >85% Mineral Rock Fibre, <15% Resin Binder, Na20+K20 16.8-18.8%, CaO 7.5-7.7%, B203 6%, Fe203 0.1-0.2%

source_excerpt:
Product Data Sheet
Thermotec Rockwool
Pre-formed Pipe Insulation
Thermotec Rockwool is a heavy duty foil faced, pre-formed pipe lagging, has a nominal 
density of 115 ~ 140 kg/m3 and is recommend to be used in applications not exceeding 
650C steam lines and most industrial and commercial applications where continuous 
higher temperatures are running.
Base Raw Material Mineral Rock 
Fibres
Volcanic diabase rock fibres 
compressed to shape with 
aluminium foil facing
Density Kg/M3 Nominal 115 ~140 Kg/M3
Cell Structure Compressed mineral fibres
Colour Yellowish/grey / Silver Foil
Service Temperature Max. 650̊̊̊C
